title: Acyclic envelopes of sheaves killed by n
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $n\ge1$ an integer and $G$ an abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with $n\cdot\mathrm{id}_G=0$. Then there are an abelian sheaf $J$ on $X_{\Et}$ with $n\cdot\mathrm{id}_J=0$ and a monomorphism $G\hookrightarrow J$ such that: (1) $H^q(X_{\Et},J)=0$ for all $q\ge1$; (2) for every morphism of schemes $f:X\to Y$, $H^q(Y_{\Et},f_*J)=0$ for all $q\ge1$, with $f_*$ the direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]; (3) for every etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] $w:W\to X$, $H^q(W_{\Et},w^{-1}J)=0$ for all $q\ge1$, with $w^{-1}$ the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Cohomology is that of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. (One may take $J=I[n]=\ker(n:I\to I)$ for an injective abelian sheaf $I\supseteq G$.)
